text:
incident-bot: 🔔 Paging: Kapstone (Enterprise) — elevated 5xx and 504s for /v1/embeddings in us-west-2. Trigger: error-rate > 5% for 10m. Pages: @oncall-jen. See diagnostics link: https://ops.redwood.example/alerts/1723456789

oncall-jen: On it. jumping in — checking fleet & routing first. pinging sam for infra context.

sam_ops: I see spike on embed-gateway-usw2, spike started ~1723456600. Autoscaler didn't spin additional nodes due to quota. CPU and queue depth high on a subset of pods.

leon_eng: Looks like a kernel-level oom kill on 2 inference pods, mem blowup around cached KV for long prompts. Rolling restart recommended for the affected node pool.

maria_cs: Kapstone is on Dedicated reserved capacity (customer-id KAP-1943). They have SRE contacts: alice.kapstone@kap.com and oncall@kapstoneops.com. Need tailored customer comm.

olivia_pm: Drafting status update for status.redwood.com and customer email. Keep it short and unequivocal.

oncall-jen: Performing rolling restarts on pool-3, will drain 1 pod at a time. ETA ~10m. I'll also temporarily redirect small percent of traffic to fallback model variant (embed-v1-lite) for Kapstone to reduce load.

incident-bot: Action logged: restart.nodepool.pool-3 by oncall-jen at 1723456825. Fallback routing applied to customer KAP-1943 -> embed-v1-lite (10% traffic).

maria_cs: Suggested tailored impact blurb for Kapstone: "We are experiencing intermittent failures for embedding requests which may return 5xx or time out. Some requests are being routed to a fallback model that returns embeddings with slightly reduced dimensionality; this may affect similarity scores for long historical queries."

olivia_pm: Nice. Shorten for status page and email subject lines. Proposals:
- Status page short: "Partial embedding disruptions for Kapstone in us-west-2 — mitigation in progress"
- Customer email subject: "Redwood update: Brief disruption to Kapstone embedding requests (us-west-2)"

leon_eng: Internal comm (ops channel) quick template: "Root cause: memory growth in KV cache for long prompt sequences -> OOM on subset of inference pods. Mitigation: rolling restarts + fallback routing to quantized variant. Next steps: patch runtime to cap KV growth, add guardrails to autoscaler config, run replay on affected traces."

maria_cs: Approving tailored blurb for customer email. Can we add expected timeline?

oncall-jen: ETA for full restore: 25-35m. I'll update when restarts complete and metrics show errors < 0.5% for 5m window.

statusbot: Draft status update saved as: /incidents/kapstone-embed-usw2-1723456789. Preview:

---
Status: Partial degradation\Scope: Kapstone (KAP-1943) - embeddings API in us-west-2\Impact: Some embedding requests may return 5xx or time out. A small percentage of traffic is routed to a fallback model with slightly different embedding dimensions.\Mitigation: Rolling restarts underway; temporary fallback routing applied; engineering investigating root cause.\ETA: 30 minutes\---

olivia_pm: Send to Kapstone CS contacts with the tailored blurb + link to status page. maria, please send and cc me.

maria_cs: Sending now to alice.kapstone@kap.com and oncall@kapstoneops.com. Email body: "Hi Alice — we’re investigating intermittent embedding errors in us-west-2 impacting some requests. We’ve applied a temporary fallback and are performing rolling restarts. Expected full restoration in ~30m. We’ll update via status.redwood.com and follow up with post-incident details. Apologies for the disruption."

maria_cs: Email sent. Thread id: msg-1723456899.

sam_ops: Quota increase for pool autoscaler requested to cloud team — request id Q-7821. If granted we can relieve pressure for sustained load.

leon_eng: Captured traces for failing requests, saving replay bucket: s3://redwood-replays/kapstone/1723456789. Will run a controlled replay to reproduce KV growth.

oncall-jen: Restarts completed on affected nodes. Error rate dropping. Monitoring p95 latency and 5xx.

incident-bot: Metric snapshot at 1723457400: error-rate 0.9% (5m), p95 latency back to baseline. Fallback routing still active (10%).

olivia_pm: Good. Maria, send a status page update now with reduced impact and ETA to remove fallback.

maria_cs: Updated status page to: "Impact reduced — errors subsiding. Fallback routing remains while we confirm stability. ETA to remove fallback: 15m."

leon_eng: Next steps logged in ops tracker:
- Runtime patch to cap KV per-seq (PR opened #3689)
- Autoscaler guard: fail-open for quota errors (task assigned to sam)
- Post-incident RCA and customer-specific appendix for Kapstone (assigned to olivia)

olivia_pm: Assigning follow-up: post-incident customer note + tailored technical appendix for Kapstone. Due EOD tomorrow.

maria_cs: Sending follow-up email update to Kapstone: "Errors reduced; we continue to monitor. We'll send a post-incident summary with technical appendix."

oncall-jen: Removing fallback routing in 10m window, will monitor metrics.

incident-bot: Action logged: fallback.routing.remove scheduled at 1723457800.

incident-bot: 1723457920 — Incident marked: mitigated. Follow-ups required: RCA, runtime patch rollout, customer appendix.

maria_cs: Final note to Kapstone sent with link to interim incident page. Closing thread here — thanks team. :thumbsup:
